text:
sara: Heads-up — dedicated pool eu-west-2-pool-7 is oscillating (2 -> 6 -> 2) ~every ~5m. Seeing customer 429s and p99 token latency spikes. Repro link: https://redwood.prod/ops/incident/2062?thread=1 :eyes:
ops-bot: [ALERT] autoscaler: scale to 6 nodes for pool eu-west-2-pool-7 (policy: latency-target) — reason: p95-latency > 300ms. alert_id=AS-7061
tom: saw that. telemetry shows CPU median low (~18%) but tail CPU for tenant 'brightcart' hits 88-93% during short bursts. Could be noisy tenant + aggressive cooldown/decay parameters.
raj: can you paste the autoscale metrics window? we suspect short spikes driving scale-ups, then cool-down bins cause scale-downs and repeat.
sara: metrics snippet:
```
autoscaler.euw2.pool7.scale_decision{window=60s} -> up
cpu.percentiles{p50=18,p95=86,p99=93}
requests.per_sec{total=420, tenant=brightcart=320}
```
lee: that p99 + tenant concentration fits. Two immediate levers: increase cooldown (120s -> 300s) OR change signal to use p95 over 5m window. also consider tenant-level rate limiting / isolation.
tom: tried bumping cooldown to 300s in staging and repro'd the pattern; flips are less frequent but still happen when bursts are sustained. we can run a short prod experiment. :thinking_face: 
sara: support-tier2, can you coordinate with BrightCart? they're reporting 429s and billing impact. need their help to pause aggressive prefetching if we change capacity. @support-tier2
support-tier2: pinged contact; brightcart says they can pause background prefetches for a 30m window if we request. they also asked for a follow-up once we stabilize. they want minimal node churn.
raj: immediate mitigation proposal:
1) bump cooldown to 300s for pool eu-west-2-pool-7
2) set min_nodes=3 during business hours (08:00-20:00 EU)
3) add smoothing: use p95 over 5m for scale decisions, ignore single-window p99 spikes
4) enable tenant isolation hints (cap 'brightcart' to 70% of a node)
I'll open a runbook PR and link metrics.
ops-bot: change-request submitted: autoscaler.cooldown=300s for pool eu-west-2-pool-7 (change-id: chg-7071) — deploying via canary rollout.
tom: logging quick repro steps for postmortem and runbook:
1) run load test hitting brightcart prefetch pattern
2) monitor autoscaler.cpu.p95 and node count
3) validate 429s reduce after isolation knobs
```bash
loadtest --pattern=brightcart-prefetch --qps=320 --duration=20m
```
sara: thanks all. will watch dashboards for next 60m and escalate to oncall if we see another flip. marking high-priority for follow-up postmortem. :white_check_mark:
